|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Anakin Skywalker (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).
* '''Original''' ([[Anakin Skywalker (V)]], 9 November 2020): Original: the image at the set's official release (9 November 2020). Players Committee card image, 9 November 2020: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-anakinskywalker-20201109.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Anakin%20Skywalker.gif Holotable commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards”], no mark). Text: “If I Feel The Conflict on table: USED: ▲ a Death Star II site. OR Relocate Prophecy Of The Force to a site. LOST: During battle at a site, if Luke armed with [Death Star II] Luke's Lightsaber, choose: Add one destiny to attrition. OR Cancel the game text of a character of ability < 4.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 18 March 2021): Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-anakinskywalker-20210318.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2f0f28b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/anakinskywalker.png Holotable commit 2f0f28b “2021 March Errata”], mark “E”). Text: “USED: Unless Twilight Is Upon Me on table, ▲ [Cloud City] or [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] Luke. LOST: During a battle at a site involving [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] or [Death Star II] Luke, choose: Add one destiny to attrition. OR Cancel the game text of a character of ability < 4.” '''What changed:''' “If I Feel The Conflict” became “USED: Unless Twilight Is Upon Me”; “table: USED:” became “table,”; “a Death Star II site. OR Relocate Prophecy Of The Force to a site.” became “[Cloud City] or [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] Luke.”; new: “a”; “site, if Luke armed with” became “site involving [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] or”; “Luke's Lightsaber,” became “Luke,”. The mark is now “E”.
*: [[File:V13-L-anakinskywalker-20210318-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Anakin Skywalker (V) (Errata 2)]], 28 March 2021): Players Committee card image, 28 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-anakinskywalker-20210328.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/35aa2a6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/large/anakinskywalker.gif Holotable commit 35aa2a6 “updates from hires”], mark “E”). Text: “USED: Unless Twilight Is Upon Me on table, ▲ [Cloud City] or [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] Luke. LOST: During a battle at a site involving [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] or [Death Star II] Luke, choose: Add one destiny to attrition. OR Cancel the game text of a character of ability < 4.” '''What changed:''' the large card image was remade from the 18 March image (745×1039, was 703×980); the corners of the bottom border differ; the words and mark are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Anakin Skywalker (V) (Errata 3)]], 20 December 2021): Players Committee card image, 20 December 2021: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-anakinskywalker.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f54fd7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/anakinskywalker.png Holotable commit 6f54fd7 “Set 17 images”], mark “E2”). Text: “During any move phase, if I Feel The Conflict on table, ▲ [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] Luke. OR During a battle at a site involving [Death Star II] Luke, choose: Add one destiny to attrition. OR Cancel the game text of a character of ability < 4.” '''What changed:''' the card became a Lost Interrupt (was Used or Lost) with new text: “During any move phase, if I Feel The Conflict on table, ▲ [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] Luke. OR During a battle at a site involving [Death Star II] Luke, choose: Add one destiny to attrition. OR Cancel the game text of a character of ability < 4.”; copyright line “© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.” added; the card prints the errata mark “E2”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E2”, but this is errata version 3 by release order (PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
